title: ShopEase
guideIntro: You're testing an e-commerce site. Browse the product listing, check the detail page, and try the checkout flow.

bugs.title: Missing alt on hero banner
bugs.description: The main banner image has no alt attribute. Screen readers cannot convey what it shows.
bugs.remediation: Add a descriptive alt attribute: alt="Summer sale — 30% off all electronics".
bugs.guideHint: Look for images that a screen reader can't describe

bugs.title: Broken product thumbnail
bugs.description: The second product card shows a broken image icon because the src points to a nonexistent file.
bugs.remediation: Fix the src to point to a valid image or use a placeholder.
bugs.guideHint: Check whether all product images load correctly

bugs.title: Low contrast on price text
bugs.description: Price labels use #94a3b8 on a #ffffff background — a contrast ratio of 3.4:1, below the 4.5:1 WCAG AA minimum for normal text.
bugs.remediation: Darken the price color to at least #64748b (contrast 5.6:1).
bugs.guideHint: Squint at the text colors — can you read everything easily?

bugs.title: Incorrect price total
bugs.description: The detail page shows a total of $149.97 for 3 items at $59.99, but 3 × $59.99 = $179.97.
bugs.remediation: Fix the calculation logic to multiply unit price by quantity correctly.
bugs.guideHint: Verify the cart math adds up

bugs.title: Add-to-cart button overlaps price
bugs.description: The 'Add to Cart' button has a negative margin that causes it to overlap the price tag, making both hard to read.
bugs.remediation: Remove the negative margin or adjust the layout spacing.
bugs.guideHint: Watch for elements sitting on top of each other

bugs.title: Email field missing label
bugs.description: The email input has placeholder text but no associated <label> element. Screen readers announce it as an unlabeled text field.
bugs.remediation: Add <label for="email">Email address</label> before the input.
bugs.guideHint: Tab through the form — does every field announce itself?

bugs.title: Place Order button is disabled
bugs.description: The submit button has a disabled attribute with no visible explanation, leaving users unable to complete their purchase.
bugs.remediation: Remove the disabled attribute or add a visible message explaining what's needed.
bugs.guideHint: Try clicking every button — do they all work?
